And we're just getting started. We grow fast. Really fast. Organically (new products, new countries) and through acquisitions: 5 companies snapped up in 3 years, including a fresh one in Spain. That's where you come in: putting Doctrine's growth in Germany into overdrive. The team you're joining A Growth team of 4: your future manager, one Growth on Italy, two on France.
